$uid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['nickname', 'joinedAt', 'round']) && newData.child('nickname').isString() && newData.child('nickname').val().length >= 1 && newData.child('nickname').val().length <= 20 && newData.child('joinedAt').val() == now && newData.child('round').isNumber() && newData.child('round').val() > now && newData.child('round').val() - now <= 7200000 && newData.child('round').val() % 7200000 == 1800000

$round..validate: newData.hasChildren(['round', 'status', 'total', 'endsAt']) && newData.child('round').isNumber() && newData.child('round').val() <= now && newData.child('round').val() % 7200000 == 1800000 && newData.child('endsAt').isNumber() && newData.child('endsAt').val() <= now && newData.child('total').isNumber() && (newData.child('status').val() == 'canceled' || (newData.child('status').val() == 'played' && newData.child('winner/nickname').isString()))
